senses.gloss: श्वा in comp. for 1. श्वन् above.
स्व॑ m. one's self, the Ego, the human soul, W.
a man of one's own people or tribe, a kinsman, relative, relation, friend (स्वाः, ‘one's own relations’, ‘one's own people’), AV. &c. &c.
स्व॑ n. (ifc. f(आ). ) one's self, the Ego (e.g. स्वं च ब्रह्म च, ‘the Ego and Brahman’)
one's own goods, property, wealth, riches (in this sense said to be also m.), RV. &c. &c.
(in alg.) plus or the affirmative quantity, W. (N.B. in the following comp. o˚ own stands for one's own.)
स्व [cf. Gk. ἕ, ὅς, σϕός; Lat. se, sovos, suus; Goth. sik; Germ. sich &c.]
2. स्व Nom. P. स्वति (pf. स्वाम्-आस) = स्व इवाचरति, he acts like himself or his kindred, Vop. xxi, 7.
स्वा॑ f. a woman of one's own caste, MBh.
